subject: Card charged twice for one order
body: My credit card statement shows two charges for one purchase at the same merchant. I am frustrated because I only placed one order. Please help me dispute the duplicate charge.

subject: Unable to access my account
body: I am locked out of online banking and the account recovery flow keeps failing. My salary is in this account and I need access to pay my rent. This is very stressful.

subject: Transfer still pending
body: My international money transfer has been pending for three days. The recipient has not received the money. I have a transfer reference and need someone to trace the payment.

subject: Unrecognized card purchases
body: There are unauthorized purchases on my stolen credit card. I did not make these transactions and I am worried someone is still using the card. Please arrange urgent review.

subject: Incorrect account on credit report
body: My credit report contains a loan that does not belong to me. I disputed the inaccurate entry with the bureau but nothing changed. The lower score is affecting my application.

subject: Collection calls after settlement
body: A debt collector keeps calling my workplace about a balance I already settled. The repeated threatening calls are unacceptable. I have the settlement receipt and need a specialist.

subject: Loan payment not credited
body: My mortgage payment was deducted but the loan statement still shows an overdue installment. Please check the payment receipt against my repayment schedule.

subject: Savings account maintenance fee
body: An unexpected maintenance fee was deducted from my savings account. I believed my account met the balance requirement. Please review the account terms.

subject: Reward points missing
body: The cash back points for my credit card purchase have not appeared on the statement. I would appreciate a review of the rewards calculation.

subject: How to trace a transfer
body: How can I track a money transfer using its reference? I would like information about the payments support process before submitting a request.

subject: Credit report correction request
body: My credit report still shows a closed loan as open. I have the closure document and would like to submit it to the credit reporting agency for a correction.

subject: Loan closure certificate
body: I paid the full amount of my vehicle loan but have not received the closure certificate. The loan servicing portal still shows an outstanding account.

subject: Account recovery completed
body: Thank you for the helpful support with recovering my online banking account. I can now sign in, but I would like to confirm how to update the phone number safely.

subject: Debt validation requested
body: I received a collection notice for a debt I do not recognize. The collection agency has not sent written verification of the creditor or the amount claimed.

subject: Unexpected mortgage interest
body: My mortgage interest rate changed and the next loan installment is larger. The lender has not explained how this matches the repayment agreement.

subject: Transfer cancellation status
body: I cancelled a wire transfer after entering the wrong recipient details. Please confirm whether cancellation is possible and what happened to the payment amount.

subject: Disputed card annual fee
body: My credit card was billed an annual membership fee although the original offer said the first year was free. Please compare the charge with the offer.

subject: Repeated bank login failure
body: The mobile banking app rejects my verification step and I cannot access my checking account. This is the third time I have contacted support about the same problem.
